title: Run hosted compiler CI when a review wave becomes ready
problem: Publishing many complete draft prerequisites can launch every expensive compiler matrix simultaneously.
example: A draft PR keeps its captured local validation; marking it ready triggers the host and device compiler jobs through ready_for_review.
design: Keep normal push and PR checks, but skip compiler jobs while the PR is draft and explicitly listen for ready_for_review.
tradeoffs: Drafts have no hosted compiler result; skipped jobs must not be described as passing. Local intermediate checks remain required before publication.
